title: Application of Western Massachusetts Electric Company under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G 1/2 and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 499, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a charge in the Company's OIl Conservation Adjustment charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant ot meter readings in the billing months of September, October, and November, 1985. The OIl Conservation Adjustment charge recovers the cost of conversion from oil-fired to coal-fired generation and its calculation is based on the respective costs of burning coal and oil.
